composio.note: Composio lists ServiceNow under 'Bring your own OAuth app', so you must supply your own client ID and secret.

need_own_app.answer: Yes. Composio has no managed OAuth app for ServiceNow, so you must register an OAuth client (application registry record) on the customer's instance and give its client ID and secret to Composio.

Managed apps show Composio branding on the consent screen

scenarios.label: Agent connecting to customers' instances
scenarios.when_this_applies: Your agent connects to each customer's own ServiceNow instance through an OAuth client registered on that instance.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count, not measured

waiting.basis: No provider review found in the docs for this setup; customer admin availability not documented.

scenarios.approval: No ServiceNow review found. The customer instance issues tokens itself, and an admin with the right role registers the client.

scenarios.label: Listing on the ServiceNow Store
scenarios.when_this_applies: You publish an app on the ServiceNow Store, which requires certification.

waiting.basis: c6 for certification; c7 for reported shorter reviews.

scenarios.approval: Store certification, separate from the OAuth client. Recertification can be required later.
extras: Reviews repeat on changes or periodically

modifiers.note: Reviews repeat on changes or periodically

prerequisites.title: Admin role on the instance
prerequisites.detail: Creating the OAuth entity needs oauth_admin; managing OAuth integration needs security_admin.

prerequisites.title: Valid TLS certificate
prerequisites.detail: Instances must not use self-signed certificates for OAuth endpoints.

steps.title: Create OAuth client in Application Registry
steps.detail: In the instance go to System OAuth > Application Registry and create the OAuth record. The client ID is auto-generated.
steps.done_when: You have the client ID and client secret.

steps.title: Copy redirect URI from Composio
steps.detail: Take the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard and check it matches what is saved in the instance.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the servicenow auth config through Composio's API with your client ID and secret.

steps.title: Submit Store certification
steps.detail: Submit the app for certification if listing on the Store.

traps.title: Self-signed certificates fail
traps.detail: The OAuth client does not allow connections to endpoints using self-signed certificates.

traps.title: Each customer needs its own setup
traps.detail: The token endpoint is on each customer's instance hostname, so client setup happens per instance.

traps.title: Managed app is not available
traps.detail: Do not plan on Composio's managed app for ServiceNow.

blockers.symptom: Cannot see Application Registry or create OAuth records
blockers.what_it_means: Your user lacks the required role.
blockers.what_to_do: Ask the instance admin for oauth_admin or security_admin.
